name: Tiramisu Cappuccino
flavor_notes: Rich espresso layered with smooth steamed milk and balanced sweetness.
barista_note: Warm the mug first so the milk and coffee stay hot to the last sip.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
preparations.tested_with: Counter Culture Big Trouble or Joe Coffee The Daily
steps: In your serving mug, combine 2 TSPS. Chocolate Sauce or Syrup and 2 TBS. Mascarpone Cheese.
Pour 2–4 oz of just-off-boil water into the mug and empty the frozen Cometeer capsule into it; stir until the syrups and coffee are fully integrated.
Warm and froth milk to about 140°F (60°C). Pour the frothed milk over the coffee, holding back the foam, then spoon the velvety foam on top.
Finish with a dusting of Speculoos Spice Cookies.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
steps: Add chocolate sauce to your serving glass.
Spoon mascarpone cheese over the chocolate sauce in the glass.
Froth milk until it has a cappuccino texture, then pour into the glass over the mascarpone.
Brew the Il Caffé capsule directly into the glass.
Crumble speculoos cookies on top as a garnish.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
preparations.tested_with: Nescafé Gold Espresso or Mount Hagen Organic
steps: In your serving mug, combine 2 TSPS. Chocolate Sauce or Syrup and 2 TBS. Mascarpone Cheese.
Dissolve 1.5–2 tsp instant espresso crystals in 2 oz (60ml) hot water directly in the mug over the syrups and spices; stir until completely dissolved.
Warm and froth milk to about 140°F (60°C). Pour the frothed milk over the coffee, holding back the foam, then spoon the velvety foam on top.
Finish with a dusting of Speculoos Spice Cookies.
